words.def: a place where you stay when you are away from home
a cheap place to stay where you often share a room with other travellers
with a kitchen, so that you cook your own meals
the bags and cases you take with you when you travel
a book that gives travellers information about a place
a small object you buy to remind you of a place you visited
the money that is used in a particular country
an agreement in which you pay a company and it pays your costs if something goes wrong
to pay to use something for a short time
to arrange and pay for something before the day you need it
done or decided at the latest possible time
belonging to a country that is not your own
far away from towns and from other people
simple, with only the things you really need and nothing extra
making you feel calm and rested

steps.title: Отметь, чему научился
items: ✓ choose the right beginning — some- in positives, any- in negatives and questions
✓ use no- with a positive verb — Nobody is serving food , There is nothing to do
✓ put the adjective in the right place — somewhere hot , nothing interesting
✓ use the singular verb — everyone is , not everyone are
✓ tell -ed from -ing — I was bored against the village was boring
✓ talk about a holiday — accommodation, hostel, self-catering, luggage, insurance, book in advance, remote
